description: The words of the settings a node's body offers, said wherever the setting is shown: a Data Pool's two conflict modes (data.dataPool, metadata.dataPool), each select's label and each mode's, and a Simple View's image column (metadata.simpleVis). The keys of dataPool.settings and dataPool.modes are the setting's keys and ResolutionType (constants.ts), in their order. Read by the Data Pool's body (adapters/node/components/DataPoolContent.tsx), the Simple View (adapters/node/simpleVisBehavior.tsx), an agent's review card (components/agents/content/reviewCard/reviewCardText.ts) and the backend, whose preview text and node.create summary say them (agents/domain/data_pool_settings.py and simple_vis_settings.py, through utk_curio/common/shared_constants.py).
